title: (RHBA-2019:2981) rh-eclipse bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary:
Updated rh-eclipse packages are now available as a part of Red Hat Developer
Tools for Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
portal_synopsis: rh-eclipse bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Developer Tools|Red Hat Developer Tools (for RHEL Server)|1|x86_64
Red Hat Developer Tools|Red Hat Developer Tools (for RHEL Workstation)|1|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:
https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The rh-eclipse4.13 packages include Eclipse 4.13, an integrated development environment (IDE), which is based on the Eclipse Foundation's 2019-09 release train.

Bug Fixes:

* Eclipse 4.7 from SCL breaks when installing Checkstyle (BZ#1529771)

For instructions on how to use rh-eclipse, see Using Eclipse linked from the References section.
